<a id="init_game_state"></a>
### [`init_game_state`](../../../src/init_machine.asm#L6) `$18E8`

*routine*

Start-up: clears samples_off, game_mode, front_fighter, shape_page_offset and keyboard_control. Sets vectors and CIAs, copies the sample period tables, sets the VIC. Called by cold_start at $1aed.

- **Called from:** [`cold_start`](bout_loop.md#cold_start) [`$1AED`](../../../src/bout_loop.asm#L111)
- **Calls:** [`init_vectors_cias`](init_machine.md#init_vectors_cias), [`init_vic_screen`](init_machine.md#init_vic_screen)
- **Reads:** [`sfx_period_lo_init`](sfx_period_tables.md#sfx_period_lo_init), [`sfx_period_lo_init+1`](sfx_period_tables.md#sfx_period_lo_init), [`sfx_period_hi_init`](sfx_period_tables.md#sfx_period_hi_init), [`sfx_period_hi_init+1`](sfx_period_tables.md#sfx_period_hi_init)
- **Writes:** [`samples_off`](../memory-map.md#samples_off), [`game_mode`](../memory-map.md#game_mode), [`front_fighter`](../memory-map.md#front_fighter), [`shape_page_offset`](../memory-map.md#shape_page_offset), [`keyboard_control`](../memory-map.md#keyboard_control), [`sfx_period_lo`](../memory-map.md#sfx_period_lo), [`sfx_period_lo+1`](../memory-map.md#sfx_period_lo), [`sfx_period_hi`](../memory-map.md#sfx_period_hi), [`sfx_period_hi+1`](../memory-map.md#sfx_period_hi), [`frame_random`](../memory-map.md#frame_random), [`scene_shown`](../memory-map.md#scene_shown)

<a id="init_vectors_cias"></a>
### [`init_vectors_cias`](../../../src/init_machine.asm#L62) `$1943`

*routine*

Switches the ROMs out ($01 = $05) and stops the CIA 1 interrupts. Enables the raster IRQ, sets the IRQ, NMI and RESET vectors and the CIA 2 timer B NMI. Called by init_game_state.

- **Called from:** [`init_game_state`](init_machine.md#init_game_state) [`$18F5`](../../../src/init_machine.asm#L14)
- **Writes:** [`cpu_port`](../memory-map.md#cpu_port), [`CIAICR`](../memory-map.md#CIAICR), [`IRQMSK`](../memory-map.md#IRQMSK), [`hw_irq_vector`](../memory-map.md#hw_irq_vector), [`hw_irq_vector+1`](../memory-map.md#hw_irq_vector), [`hw_reset_vector`](../memory-map.md#hw_reset_vector), [`hw_reset_vector+1`](../memory-map.md#hw_reset_vector), [`CI2ICR`](../memory-map.md#CI2ICR), [`hw_nmi_vector`](../memory-map.md#hw_nmi_vector), [`hw_nmi_vector+1`](../memory-map.md#hw_nmi_vector), [`CI2TBLO`](../memory-map.md#CI2TBLO), [`CI2TBHI`](../memory-map.md#CI2TBHI), [`CIADDRA`](../memory-map.md#CIADDRA)
